name: ModelVariant818_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant818_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (once the start time passes a single bolt leaves a model point with a burst of launch debris and flies towards a jittered point on the opposing slot, wrapped in a ring of four-way flares and spinning Gouraud strips and trailing a ribbon and smoke puffs; on arrival it flares into a glow with impact chips, dust, shards and animated sparks, 64 spinning semi-transparent blades and a pulsing shock fan while the ambient light dims and recovers); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, seeds the bolt, debris and blades and packs eleven texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 before the start time, 1 once when the bolt arrives, 2 once the glow has faded after the light recovers and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-835 and 932 images build it from the same source. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
